title: Warm Middle Eastern Kidney Beans Fatteh
description: A yeasty and crunchy plant-based Middle Eastern dish featuring kidney beans, served in a traditional tajine clay vessel, perfect for a romantic dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the pita bread into small cubes and toast until crispy.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the kidney beans, sumac, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, mix the yeast and water to create a yeast sauce.
Add the yeast sauce to the skillet and stir to combine with the kidney bean mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
To assemble the fatteh, place a layer of toasted pita bread in the bottom of a tajine clay vessel.
Add a layer of the kidney bean mixture on top of the pita bread, followed by a drizzle of lemon juice mixture.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of toasted pita bread on top.
